about: Charter Communications is a Stamford, Connecticut-based US cable operator, offering Spectrum internet, mobile, TV and voice to about 57 million customers in 41 states, plus Spectrum Business, Spectrum Reach advertising and Spectrum News channels. Revenue is around $55 billion. Listed on Nasdaq (CHTR), and in 2025 it agreed to merge with Cox Communications. Very high consumer brand awareness in the US, and holder of sports media rights such as Lakers broadcasts via Spectrum SportsNet.

Comcast is a US media and technology conglomerate headquartered in Philadelphia and listed on Nasdaq (CMCSA). It owns Xfinity broadband and cable, NBCUniversal (NBC, Peacock, Universal Pictures, theme parks, Telemundo), Sky in Europe, and the Versant cable spin-off planned for 2026. It has over 30 million broadband customers and revenue near 120 billion dollars. Money comes from subscriptions, advertising, film and theme park admissions. Huge consumer brands and a major sports broadcaster, including NFL, Premier League and the Olympics, so a likely media partner.

wiki.title: Comcast
wiki.what: American multinational telecommunications and media conglomerate
wiki.text: Comcast is an American multinational mass media, telecommunications, and entertainment conglomerate. Comcast's corporate headquarters is at the Comcast Center in Philadelphia, while NBCUniversal, Comcast's New York operations and other major Comcast assets are headquartered at 30 Rockefeller Plaza in Midtown Manhattan in New York City. The company was ranked 51st in the Forbes Global 2000 in 2023. It is the fourth-largest telecommunications company by worldwide revenue, after AT&T, Verizon, and China Mobile. Comcast is the third-largest pay-TV company, the second-largest cable TV company by subscribers, and the largest home Internet service p

about: Legendary Entertainment is a Burbank-based film, television and media company founded in 2000 by Thomas Tull and owned by China's Dalian Wanda Group since 2016. It produces and co-finances blockbusters such as Dune, Godzilla and Kong, the Jurassic World series (as financing partner), plus the Legendary Comics and television arms. Customers are studios, streamers and audiences; revenue comes from film, licensing and distribution. Strong entertainment brand with a track record of branded content partnerships.

wiki.title: Legendary Entertainment
wiki.text: Legendary Entertainment, LLC is an American mass media company based in Burbank, California. It was founded by film producer Thomas Tull in 2003 after he was fired from Convex Group. The company has often collaborated with the major studios, including Warner Bros. Pictures, Universal Pictures, Sony Pictures, and Paramount Pictures, as well as streaming services such as Netflix and Hulu.

about: Nexstar Media Group is the largest US local television station owner, headquartered in Irving, Texas and listed on Nasdaq (NXST), with over 200 stations reaching about 39 percent of US households, plus national cable network NewsNation and The CW. Revenue is around 5 billion dollars from retransmission fees and advertising, including political ads. Founded 1996. In 2025 it agreed to acquire Tegna. Audience-facing media company with large reach among US local viewers, relevant for advertising.

iQiyi is one of China's largest online video platforms, streaming original series, films, variety shows, anime and licensed content, with revenue from membership subscriptions, advertising, content licensing and other services. Customers are Chinese viewers and advertisers, with international service in Southeast Asia and elsewhere. Headquartered in Beijing, founded in 2010, controlled by search giant Baidu. Listed on Nasdaq (IQ). Very strong consumer brand in China, with a wide base of paying members.

Gamma is a Los Angeles-based media and music company founded in 2021 by Larry Jackson, former head of Apple Music and Interscope Geffen, which backs artists and creators through a record label, publishing and film and television ventures. It raised about 1 billion dollars in a 2021 deal with Apple, Hollywood financiers and other backers. Customers are audiences streaming music, and Gamma earns revenue from recorded music, rights and content deals. Mid-level brand awareness, with artist signings such as Usher and Mary J. Blige adjacent partners; entertainment-sector fit.
cb_desc: gamma operates as a modern media and music company.

about: New Pluto Global is a United States company (Crunchbase lists New York) described as a creative-driven site for storytellers and content creators, in the content and creator-economy space. Crunchbase shows total funding of about $2.4 billion, which looks unusually large for that description, so the entry should be verified. Its products, customers and ownership cannot be confirmed from the data available. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: Canal+ Group is a French pay-television and film company running the Canal+ premium channels, themed channels, streaming services and the StudioCanal production and distribution arm. It serves millions of subscribers in France, Africa, Poland, Vietnam and elsewhere, earning revenue from subscriptions, advertising and content. It was historically part of Vivendi, was spun off and listed on the London Stock Exchange in December 2024, and has been acquiring MultiChoice in South Africa. It is a well known consumer media brand and a major sports rights holder.

Cirque du Soleil is a Canadian entertainment company founded in 1984 in Quebec, producing touring and resident live acrobatic shows such as O, Mystere, Kooza and Corteo in Las Vegas and around the world. Customers are ticket-buying audiences and corporate clients for events. Based in Montreal, with thousands of artists and staff. It restructured through bankruptcy in 2020 and passed to its lenders. Highly recognised consumer brand in much of the world.

wiki.title: Cirque du Soleil
wiki.text: The Cirque du Soleil Entertainment Group, commonly known as Cirque du Soleil, is a Canadian entertainment company and the largest contemporary circus producer in the world. Headquartered in the inner-city area of Saint-Michel, Montreal, it was founded in Baie-Saint-Paul on 16 June 1984 by former street performers Guy Laliberté and Gilles Ste-Croix.

about: Blacknut is a French cloud gaming service, based in Cesson-Sevigne near Rennes, founded in 2016, offering a subscription catalogue of PC and console-style games streamed to TVs, phones and PCs, and distribution partnerships with telecom operators and device makers. Funding shown is about $215 million. Consumer and B2B2C brand with a modest profile.

K Wave Media is a Korean-focused media and entertainment company, with a Grand Cayman registered address, that Crunchbase says develops content and franchises tied to the Korean wave, including music, television and fan experiences. Funding of about $1.0 billion is shown, which should be verified. Specific shows, artists, ownership and scale were not confirmed. Likely entertainment brand with moderate awareness among K-culture fans. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: JMGO is a Shenzhen-based Chinese maker of smart home projectors, including the N-series and O-series laser and LED models, developing hardware, optics and an Android-based system. Customers are consumers buying home cinema and portable projectors through online platforms, Amazon and retail, and the brand sells in dozens of countries. Founded around 2011, it is one of China's leading projector brands, with Crunchbase showing about 379 million dollars of funding up to 2023. Consumer electronics brand with growing international visibility in the home entertainment segment.
cb_desc: JMGO specializes in R&D and production of smart projectors...

about: Nordic streaming and media group, spun out of Modern Times Group in 2018 and renamed Viaplay Group in 2022. Runs the Viaplay streaming service, Viaplay-branded sports and entertainment TV channels, a film and series studio business, and commercial radio in the Nordics and Baltics. It held Formula 1 rights in the Nordics and the Netherlands before pulling back from many markets after losses and a financial restructuring in 2023-24. Revenue came from subscriptions and advertising, in the billions of Swedish kronor. Well-known consumer streaming brand in Scandinavia.

Iliad is a French telecom group, founded by Xavier Niel and based in Paris, behind the Free mobile and broadband brand in France, plus Iliad Italia, Play in Poland and a stake in other operators. It serves over 50 million subscribers, with revenue around EUR 11bn, and owns data center and fibre assets, including OpCore. Privately held, controlled by Niel's holding after delisting in 2018. Free is a strong disruptive consumer brand in France.

wiki.title: Iliad
wiki.text: The Iliad is one of two major surviving ancient Greek epic poems, along with the Odyssey, attributed to Homer. It is one of the oldest extant works of literature still widely read by modern readers. Like the Odyssey, the poem is divided into 24 books and was written in dactylic hexameter. It contains 15,693 lines in its standard edition. The Iliad is often regarded as the first substantial piece of European literature and is central to the study of classical philology.

wiki.title: Iliad SA
wiki.text: Iliad SA, stylized as iliad, is a French telecommunications company. It is based in Paris and its operations comprise fixed and mobile telephony services, prepaid phone cards and Internet access providing and hosting services.

about: Verizon is a US telecom giant, based in Basking Ridge, New Jersey, serving about 145 million mobile and broadband connections with wireless, Fios fibre, 5G home internet and business services. It earns subscription fees and has revenue near $135bn. Listed on the NYSE and Nasdaq (VZ). Very strong consumer brand and a major sports sponsor, notably as an NFL partner and in IndyCar. Funding figure shown reflects debt raised rather than venture equity.

wiki.title: Verizon
wiki.text: Verizon Communications Inc. is an American telecommunications company headquartered in New York City. It is the world's second-largest telecommunications company by revenue and its mobile network is the largest wireless carrier in the United States, with 146.8 million subscribers as of March 31, 2026. The company was founded as Bell Atlantic Corporation and renamed to Verizon on June 30, 2000 as a result of a merger with GTE.

about: Zayo is a Denver-based fibre network and bandwidth provider operating long-haul and metro fibre across North America and Europe, selling dark fibre, wavelengths and Ethernet to carriers, hyperscalers and enterprises. It was taken private in 2020 by Digital Colony and EQT for about $14bn and agreed to acquire Crown Castle's fibre business in 2025. Private. B2B network provider, without consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Zayo Group
wiki.text: Zayo Group, Inc. is a digital infrastructure company providing fiber-optic networks, high-capacity connectivity, and networking solutions to enterprises, hyperscalers, cloud and content providers, data centers, and telecommunications carriers worldwide.

about: Crown Castle is a US real estate investment trust headquartered in Houston, Texas and listed on the NYSE (CCI) that owns about 40,000 cell towers, plus small cells and fibre, leased to wireless carriers such as T-Mobile, AT&T and Verizon. It agreed in 2025 to sell its fibre and small-cell units to Zayo and EQT for around 8.5 billion dollars. Revenue is about 6 billion dollars. Founded 1994. B2B infrastructure with no consumer visibility.

Eaton Fiber is described by Crunchbase as a wholesale fibre-to-the-premises network provider powering internet service providers, and is listed with a New York address and classified under Internet. Crunchbase shows about $1.5 billion in total funding, likely mostly debt and infrastructure capital. Customers, scale of the network and ownership are not stated in the available data. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

Crunchbase shows about $1.37 billion in total funding, likely infrastructure investment and debt. Details on service areas, customers and ownership are not provided in the available data. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: Nairobi-based telecom operator, owned about 55 percent by Bharti Airtel, providing mobile and mobile-money services to about 160 million customers in 14 African countries. Listed in London and Lagos. Revenue is about $5 billion. Strong consumer brand across Africa and sponsor of football. Airtel Africa has operations in Nigeria, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, Zambia and others, and is a significant sponsor of cricket and football on the continent.

wiki.title: Airtel Africa
wiki.text: Airtel Africa plc is a British company that provides telecommunications and mobile money services in 14 countries in Africa, mainly in East, Central and West Africa. Airtel Africa is majority owned by the Indian telecommunications company Bharti Airtel. Airtel Africa offers mobile voice and data services as well as mobile money services both nationally and internationally. Airtel Nigeria is the most profitable unit of Airtel Africa, due to its cheap data plans in Nigeria. As of March 2019, Airtel had over 99 million subscribers in the continent. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a constituent of the FTSE 100 Index.

about: Dallas-based US telecom provider offering fibre internet and voice to consumers and businesses in about 25 states. Verizon agreed to acquire it for around $20 billion in 2024-25. Consumer brand in its regions. Revenue is about $5.8 billion. After the acquisition completes it will operate within Verizon. Consumer brand in regions such as California, Texas and Florida. Frontier is rolling out fibre across its regions, and the company has about 3 million fibre customers.

Terrion is a telecommunications company based in Montreal, Quebec, Canada. Crunchbase says it creates secure and sustainable communication solutions. Total funding is shown as roughly 1.26 billion dollars, an unusually large amount for a company with this profile, so figures should be verified. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: Manchester-based UK multi-utility services specialist working in regulated utilities, infrastructure and telecoms, according to the input. Customers likely include utility and network companies. No ownership, scale or products are confirmed. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)
cb_desc: OCU Group is a multi-utility services specialist in regulate...

about: Celero Communications is an Irvine, California fabless semiconductor company developing coherent DSP chips and optical connectivity solutions for data center and telecom networks, per Crunchbase, with about $413 million in funding. Customers would be network equipment makers and cloud providers. Private B2B with little public brand awareness. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

China Mobile is the world's largest mobile operator by subscribers, with around a billion mobile customers, plus broadband, 5G, cloud and data services in China. It is majority owned by the Chinese state through China Mobile Communications Group, with a Hong Kong listing (0941) and a Shanghai listing (600941). Its headquarters are in Beijing, with the Hong Kong office shown here. Revenue is about 130 billion dollars. It is a hugely visible consumer brand in China, with extensive advertising and sports sponsorship.

wiki.title: China Mobile
wiki.text: China Mobile is the trade name of both China Mobile Limited, and its ultimate controlling shareholder, China Mobile Communications Group Co., Ltd., a Chinese state-owned telecommunications company. It provides mobile voice and multimedia services through its nationwide mobile telecommunications network across mainland China and Hong Kong. China Mobile is the largest wireless carrier in China, with 945.50 million subscribers as of June 2021. China Mobile was ranked #25 in Forbes' Global 2000 in 2023.

about: KORE Wireless is a US Internet of Things (IoT) connectivity and solutions provider, based in Atlanta, Georgia, offering cellular IoT connectivity management, devices, fleet tracking and analytics to enterprises, healthcare, transportation and industrial customers. It went public in 2021 through a SPAC merger with Cerberus Telecom Acquisition Corp (NYSE: KORE) and has over 18 million connections. B2B with little consumer brand awareness.

wiki.title: KORE Wireless
wiki.text: KORE Wireless is a privately-owned company that provides IoT connectivity, managed services, and related solutions. The company supports applications across sectors including healthcare, logistics, fleet, utilities, and industrial automation, with more than 20 million active connections reported worldwide.
